verses.1: A psalm. Sing a new song to the LORD, who has done marvelous deeds, Whose right hand and holy arm have won the victory.
verses.2: The LORD has made his victory known; has revealed his triumph for the nations to see,
verses.3: Has remembered faithful love toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.
verses.4: Shout with joy to the LORD, all the earth; break into song; sing praise.
verses.5: Sing praise to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and melodious song.
verses.6: With trumpets and the sound of the horn shout with joy to the King, the LORD.
verses.7: Let the sea and what fills it resound, the world and those who dwell there.
verses.8: Let the rivers clap their hands, the mountains shout with them for joy,
verses.9: Before the LORD who comes, who comes to govern the earth, To govern the world with justice and the peoples with fairness.

notes.text: Marvelous deeds... victory: the conquest of all threats to the peaceful existence of Israel, depicted in the psalms variously as a cosmic force such as sea, or nations bent on Israel's destruction, or evildoers seemingly triumphant. Whose right hand and holy arm: God is pictured as a powerful warrior.
